title: 第21章 回城第22章 辗转难眠
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
一直到临近傍晚时分，叶凌和血幽的战斗终于结束了。
“叮！
恭喜宿主的灵宠血幽，成功的达到一阶四级，获得自由点X1。”
随着战斗结束，原本已经99％多一点的经验值，也终于达到了100％。
同时，血幽等级再度提升，成功的来到了一阶四级。
至于叶凌，他的等级同样也跟着来到了一阶四级。
这种事情说出去恐怕都没人相信，竟然有人可以做到一天连升两级。
如果不是亲眼所见的话，说不定有人真的会以为叶凌这是在做梦。
当然，这也多亏了系统给的经验值奖励，以及本身的经验值量化。
要知道系统提供了两次经验值奖励，每次都是50％，这就已经够升一级了。
和其他人不同，叶凌不存在桎梏，只要有足够的经验值，就能升级。
已经获得大半年灵宠的霍仙儿，现在也只不过是将灵宠培养到了一阶七级。
排除掉刚开始的时候，需要花费一定时间培养成长。
霍仙儿真正带着地苍龙开始战斗，怎么着也有三个月以上时间了。
能够达到现在实力，确实已经算是非常厉害了。
从这就可以看出，一天之内连升两级，是一件多么令人难以置信的事情。
今天的任务总算是完成了，此时天色已经渐晚，叶凌带着血幽快速的离开了葬骨丘。
要知道在野外，夜晚是更加危险的。
因为有很多昼伏夜出的魔物，在夜晚的时候才会出来行动。
都失去了太阳的照射，没有光芒的情况下，面对更加凶恶的魔兽，太危险了。

就算是叶凌，也无法保证自己一定能够不受伤。
今天自己的目的已经达到了，那就没必要去冒这个险。
在撤离葬骨丘之后，叶凌将血幽重新收回了灵宠印。
这里，距离天辉城已经非常近了，周围并不存在什么非常厉害的魔兽。
不用担心会受到什么袭击之类的，这也是为什么叶凌敢将血幽收回到灵宠印的原因。
凭借着身份证明，叶凌再次回到了这熟悉的天辉城。
以往的时候，看这座城市怎么看怎么讨厌。
因为那个时候，叶凌已经注定无法变强，要么成为普通人，要么进入军队，成为一个普通士兵。
如果想要生活的更好，也可以去当佣兵，虽然非常危险，但是收入更高。
高收入往往代表的也是高风险。
这样的生活，叶凌看不到任何的希望，自然就非常讨厌这座城市。
但是现在却不一样了。
content_en:
Until late in the evening, the battle between Ye Ling and Xue You finally ended.
“Ding!
Congratulations to the host's spiritual pet, Xue You, for successfully reaching level one and level four and gaining freedom points X1. "
With the end of the battle, the experience value, which was already a little over 99%, finally reached 100%.
At the same time, Xueyou's level increased again, successfully reaching the first and fourth levels.
As for Ye Ling, his level also reached level one and level four.
I'm afraid no one will believe this kind of thing. There are people who can achieve two levels in a day.
If they hadn't seen it with their own eyes, some people might really think that Ye Ling was dreaming.
Of course, this is also thanks to the experience value rewards given by the system and its own experience value quantification.
You must know that the system provides two experience point rewards, each time is 50%, which is enough to level up.
Unlike others, Ye Ling has no shackles. As long as he has enough experience points, he can level up.
Huo Xian'er, who has been a spiritual pet for more than half a year, has only raised the spiritual pet to the first and seventh levels.
Excluding the initial stage, it takes a certain amount of time to cultivate and grow.
It took more than three months before Huo Xianer actually started fighting with Di Canglong.
To be able to reach the current strength is indeed very powerful.
From this we can see how incredible it is to be upgraded to two levels in one day.
Today's mission was finally completed. It was getting late at this time. Ye Ling and Xueyou quickly left the Bone Burial Hill.
You must know that in the wild, night is more dangerous.
Because there are many nocturnal monsters that only come out to act at night.
They have lost the sun's rays. Without light, it is too dangerous to face more ferocious monsters.
Even Ye Ling couldn't guarantee that he would not be injured.
Today, my goal has been achieved, so there is no need to take this risk.
After evacuating the Bone Burial Mound, Ye Ling took Xue You back into his spiritual pet seal.
Here, it is very close to Tianhui City, and there are no very powerful monsters around.
There is no need to worry about being attacked. This is why Ye Ling dared to take Xueyou back to the spiritual pet seal.
With his identity certificate, Ye Ling returned to the familiar Tianhui City again.
In the past, this city was disgusting to look at.
Because at that time, Ye Ling was already destined to be unable to become stronger and had to either become an ordinary person or join the army and become an ordinary soldier.
If you want a better life, you can also become a mercenary. Although it is very dangerous, the income is higher.
High income often represents high risk.
Ye Ling couldn't see any hope in such a life, so he naturally hated this city very much.
But it's different now.
